decisions.reason: The supplied contract states, in English, that when signal transmission fails the transition endpoint pair must be BrakingState to OperationalState. The exact closed-model inventory instead contains the signal-failure transition from InitialState to OperationalState and no transition from the exactly bound BrakingState to OperationalState. The alternative reading that the clause concerns failure from InitialState is explicitly excluded by the supplied candidate contract, which fixes BrakingState as the source.
decisions.violated_obligation: On signal transmission failure, an exact transition from BrakingState to OperationalState is required.

decisions.basis: Obligation 0001:r3:i1 dossier: exact owner and BrakingState bindings, owner-local initial-entry inventory, S2 plan, and completed FCSTM receipt.
decisions.reason: The supplied derived contract requires the basic braking device to enter BrakingState as its owner-local initial entry for the post-entry sequence. The exact model facts show the root initial edge entering InitialState and no owner-local initial edge entering BrakingState. The normal InitialState-to-BrakingState transition is event-triggered and therefore does not satisfy the distinct owner-local initial-edge property. That separate transition is not a competent rebuttal to the exact obligation.
decisions.violated_obligation: The basic braking device must have an owner-local initial edge entering BrakingState.

decisions.basis: Obligation 0001:r3:i2 dossier: exact failure event, source and target bindings, closed transition inventory, S2 plan, and completed FCSTM receipt.

The exact bound model fact places that event transition from InitialState to OperationalState, while the complete inventory has no BrakingState-to-OperationalState transition. A possible reading in which the clause describes an initial-state failure path is not competent here because the supplied atomic contract explicitly binds BrakingState as the source.
decisions.violated_obligation: Signal_Transmission_Fails must trigger a transition from BrakingState to OperationalState.

decisions.basis: Obligation 0001:r3:i3 dossier: exact owner, BrakingState, InitialState, transition, and event bindings, owner-local initial-entry facts, S2 plan, and completed FCSTM receipt.
